fishing: WHEN: Fri Oct 23 post-front with NE breezes, conditions improving. PASSES-BEACH: still some residual wind effects; redfish near passes on live shrimp or pilchards. LEMON BAY: redfish, small snook, mangrove snapper around docks/mangroves/oyster bars; trout on flats. NEARSHORE: limited windows for mangrove snapper on reefs. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, gold spoons.
redtide: FWC Oct 16: K. brevis at background concentrations in 6 samples from/offshore SWFL (Sarasota in/offshore, Hillsborough offshore). Not present Charlotte/Lee. No fish kills or respiratory irritation past week. Next report today Oct 23.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD ~10 CFU/100mL (DOH Charlotte Healthy Beaches). No advisory. Manasota Key similar good.
fpl: Charlotte ~3 outages, Sarasota ~148 outages (recent trackers); small isolated only, no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
